deltas.owner_words: The start-up failure card has no logo and no "Reload the page" button. The design puts the on_light logo (on_dark in the dark theme) at the top of the card, with a Reload button under the message. The build put those two logos in a page footer instead, and the design has no logo in the footer. The asset checks R8.17 and R8.18 pass only because they compare the files' bytes, not where the logos are shown. Fix: move the <picture> into the #startup-error card and add the Reload button. Nothing was rendered: this rests on the served HTML, CSS and scripts read over HTTP. observed_on says "browser" only because the review schema has no value for a read that is not rendered.

Recommendation for the next design revision, not decided in this review: Out-of-range messages are the raw RangeError text with internal names and no units, for example "m1 must be a number from 0.1 to 10" (friction says "inclineDeg", trajectory "angleDeg" and "dragCoefficient"). An empty prediction gets the same generic message, and the summary is always headed "Check these values". The mockup shows "m₁ must be from 0.1 to 10 kg — you entered 12.", a counted heading ("Two things to fix before you run:") and "Enter your prediction to run the experiment." The design's notes also say "the RangeError message", so the next design revision should make binding the player-facing wording (symbol, unit, the value entered), and the build should then follow it. Nothing was rendered: this rests on the served HTML, CSS and scripts read over HTTP. observed_on says "browser" only because the review schema has no value for a read that is not rendered.

Recommendation for the next design revision, not decided in this review: The prediction slider runs from −30 to 30 m/s in the build; the mockup shows −10 to 10. The build is right and the design is wrong: an elastic collision can give v₂′ up to about 29.6 m/s (m₁ = 10 kg, m₂ = 0.1 kg, v₁ = 10, v₂ = −10), so −10 to 10 would refuse correct answers. The owner agrees the design is wrong and the build is right; the next design revision should change it to −30 to 30. Nothing was rendered: this rests on the served HTML, CSS and scripts read over HTTP. observed_on says "browser" only because the review schema has no value for a read that is not rendered.

The "Why" sentence can say something false when cart 2 is already moving (R6.1). With m₁ > m₂ it always says cart 1 "keeps going", but with m₁ = 2, m₂ = 1, v₁ = 1, v₂ = −10 cart 1 bounces back at −6.33 m/s. With m₁ < m₂ it always says cart 1 "bounces back", but with m₁ = 1, m₂ = 2, v₁ = 10, v₂ = 9 it keeps going at 8.67 m/s. The sentence should follow the sign of v₁′. The owner would fix this first. Nothing was rendered: this rests on the served HTML, CSS and scripts read over HTTP. observed_on says "browser" only because the review schema has no value for a read that is not rendered.
